44553-letters-of-samuel-taylor-coleridge.creator: Unknown
44553-letters-of-samuel-taylor-coleridge.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Dykes Campbell, I can only say that he has spared neither time nor trouble in my behalf. Not only during the progress of the work has he been ready to give me the benefit of his unrivalled knowledge of the correspondence and history of Coleridge and of his contemporaries, but he has largely assisted me in seeing the work through the press.

59253-attack-of-fortified-places-includi.creator: Unknown
59253-attack-of-fortified-places-includi.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In selecting them I have drawn freely upon the textbooks of the schools of military engineering at Chatham, Fontainebleau, Vienna, and Berlin, as well as upon that of the late Professor Mahan, and the manuals of Duane and Ernst.

723-henry-james-jr.title: Henry James, Jr.
723-henry-james-jr.creator: William Dean Howells
723-henry-james-jr.description: A book by William Dean Howells. take it?" asked my chief. "Yes, and all the stories you can get from the writer." One is much securer of one's judgment at twenty-nine than, say, at forty-five; but if this was a mistake of mine I am not yet old enough to regret it.

arxiv-2102-13303.title: Graph-based Semi-supervised Learning: A Comprehensive Review
arxiv-2102-13303.creator: Zixing Song, Xiangli Yang, Zenglin Xu, Irwin King
arxiv-2102-13303.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has tremendous value in practice due to its ability to utilize both labeled data and unlabelled data. An important class of SSL methods is to naturally represent data as graphs such that the label information of unlabelled samples can be inferred from the graphs, which corresponds to graph-based semi-supervised learning (GSSL) methods.

arxiv-2201-07063.title: How to Backdoor HyperNetwork in Personalized Federated Learning?
arxiv-2201-07063.creator: Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan, Abdallah Khreishah, Issa Khalil, Xintao Wu
arxiv-2201-07063.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan, Abdallah Khreishah, Issa Khalil, Xintao Wu. This paper explores previously unknown backdoor risks in HyperNet-based personalized federated learning (HyperNetFL) through poisoning attacks. Based upon that, we propose a novel model transferring attack (called HNTroj ), i.e., the first of its kind, to transfer a local backdoor infected model to all legitimate and personalized local models, which are generated by the HyperNetFL model, through consistent and effective malicious local gradients computed across all compromised clients in the whole training process.

arxiv-2204-11344.title: On a Frequency-Stabilized Single Current Inverse Source Formulation
arxiv-2204-11344.creator: Francesco P. Andriulli
arxiv-2204-11344.description: Abstract Several strategies are available for solving the inverse source problem in electromagnetics. Among them, many have been focusing in retrieving Love currents by solving, after regularization, for Love’s electric and magnetic currents. In this work we present a dual-element discretization, analysis, and stabilization of an inverse source formulation providing Love data by solving for only one current.

arxiv-2208-02630.title: A Contribution Management Framework for Firms Engaged in Open Source Software Ecosystems - A Research Preview
arxiv-2208-02630.creator: Johan Linåker and Björn Regnell
arxiv-2208-02630.description: Abstract Contribution Management helps firms engaged in Open Source Software (OSS) ecosystems to create contribution strategies which motivate what they should contribute and when, but also what they should focus their resources on and to what extent. The motivation for developing tailored contribution strategies is to maximize return on investment and sustain the influence needed in the ecosystem.

arxiv-2210-01892.title: Polysemanticity and Capacity in Neural Networks
arxiv-2210-01892.creator: Adam Scherlis, Kshitij Sachan, Adam S. Jermyn, Joe Benton, Buck Shlegeris
arxiv-2210-01892.description: Abstract Individual neurons in neural networks often represent a mixture of unrelated features. This phenomenon, called polysemanticity, can make interpreting neural networks more difficult and so we aim to understand its causes. We propose doing so through the lens of feature capacity , which is the fractional dimension each feature consumes in the embedding space.

arxiv-2303-16228.title: Disk flaring with TNG50: diversity across Milky Way and M31 analogs
arxiv-2303-16228.creator: Diego Sotillo-Ramos, Martina Donnari, Annalisa Pillepich, Neige Frankel, Dylan Nelson, Volker Springel, Lars Hernquist
arxiv-2303-16228.description: Abstract We use the sample of 198 Milky Way (MW) and Andromeda (M31) analogs from TNG50 to quantify the level of disk flaring predicted by a modern, high-resolution cosmological hydrodynamical simulation. Disk flaring refers to the increase of vertical stellar disk height with galactocentric distance.

arxiv-2402-03303.title: Nevermind: Instruction Override and Moderation in Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-03303.creator: Edward Kim
arxiv-2402-03303.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Edward Kim. Given the impressive capabilities of recent Large Language Models (LLMs), we investigate and benchmark the most popular proprietary and different sized open source models on the task of explicit instruction following in conflicting situations, e.g. These include the ability of the model to override the knowledge within the weights of the model, the ability to override (or moderate) extracted knowledge in the prompt, and lastly the ability to perform a full jailbreak.

arxiv-2402-10354.title: A Heterotic Hermitian–Yang–Mills Equivalence
arxiv-2402-10354.creator: Jock McOrist
arxiv-2402-10354.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jock McOrist. \proofmodefalse We consider N=1 , d=4 vacua of heterotic theories in the large radius limit in which {{\alpha}^{\backprime}\,}\ll 1 . We construct a real differential operator \mathcal{D}=D+\bar{D} on an extension bundle (Q,\mathcal{D}) with underlying topology Q=(T^{1,0}X)^{*}\oplus{\rm End}\,E\oplus T^{1,0}X whose curvature is holomorphic and Hermitian-Yang-Mills with respect to the complex structure and metric on the underlying non-Kähler complex 3-fold X if and only if the heterotic supersymmetry equations and Bianchi identity are satisfied.

arxiv-2403-02169.title: A theoretical basis for cell deaths
arxiv-2403-02169.creator: Yusuke Himeoka, Shuhei A. Horiguchi, Tetsuya J. Kobayashi
arxiv-2403-02169.description: Abstract Understanding deaths and life-death boundaries of cells is a fundamental challenge in biological sciences. In this study, we present a theoretical framework for investigating cell death. We conceptualize cell death as a controllability problem within dynamical systems, and compute the life-death boundary through the development of “stoichiometric rays”.

arxiv-2404-12109.title: Revisiting holographic model for thermal and dense QCD with a critical point
arxiv-2404-12109.creator: Qingxuan Fu, Song He, Li Li, Zhibin Li
arxiv-2404-12109.description: Abstract To quantitatively provide reliable predictions for the hot and dense QCD matter, a holographic model should be adjusted to describe first-principles lattice results available at vanishing baryon chemical potential. The equation of state from two well-known lattice groups, the HotQCD collaboration and the Wuppertal-Budapest (WB) collaboration, shows visible differences at high temperatures.

arxiv-2408-06975.title: SpectralGaussians: Semantic, spectral 3D Gaussian splatting for multi-spectral scene representation, visualization and analysis
arxiv-2408-06975.creator: Saptarshi Neil Sinha, Holger Graf, Michael Weinmann
arxiv-2408-06975.description: Abstract We propose a novel cross-spectral rendering framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that generates realistic and semantically meaningful splats from registered multi-view spectrum and segmentation maps. This extension enhances the representation of scenes with multiple spectra, providing insights into the underlying materials and segmentation.

arxiv-2602-04403.title: The optimal chromatic bound for even-hole-free graphs without induced seven-vertex paths
arxiv-2602-04403.creator: Shenwei Huang, Yidong Zhou, Yeonsu Chang
arxiv-2602-04403.description: Abstract The class of even-hole-free graphs has been extensively studied on its own and on its relation to perfect graphs. In this paper, we study the χ \chi -boundedness of even-hole-free graphs which itself is an important topic in graph theory.

bruno-de-magia-latin.creator: Giordano Bruno
bruno-de-magia-latin.description: Bruno's De Magia (Latin) — the systematic treatise on magical bonds and the magic of attraction; the philosophical peak of Renaissance magic theory.

pmc-10668748.title: Effects of Dietary Bacillus coagulans and Tributyrin on Growth Performance, Serum Antioxidants, Intestinal Morphology, and Cecal Microbiota of Growing Yellow-Feathered Broilers
pmc-10668748.creator: Jinwang Hou, Lina Lian, Lizhi Lu, Tiantian Gu, Tao Zeng, Li Chen, Wenwu Xu, Guoqin Li, Hongzhi Wu, Yong Tian, Alessandro Dal Bosco
pmc-10668748.description: Simple SummaryBacillus coagulans and tributyrin are important feed additives and both can improve the health of animals when used alone. Here, we found that the combination of Bacillus coagulans and tributyrin glycerin improved the antioxidant capacity, intestinal morphology, and composition of the intestinal microbiota of yellow-feathered broilers to a certain extent. We further found that these effects were synergistic.

pmc-11345813.title: Revealing Ion Adsorption and Charging Mechanisms in Layered Metal–Organic Framework Supercapacitors with Solid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
pmc-11345813.creator: Chloe
pmc-11345813.description: Conductive layered metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have demonstrated promising electrochemical performances as supercapacitor electrode materials. The well-defined chemical structures of these crystalline porous electrodes facilitate structure–performance studies; however, there is a fundamental lack in the molecular-level understanding of charge storage mechanisms in conductive layered MOFs.

pmc-11487498.title: Thiol-Specific Linkers for the Synthesis of Oligonucleotide Conjugates via Metal-Free Thiol–Ene Click Reaction
pmc-11487498.creator: Anna L Malinowska, Harley L Huynh, Andrés F Correa-Sánchez, Sritama Bose
pmc-11487498.description: Chemical conjugation of oligonucleotides is widely used to improve their delivery and therapeutic potential. A variety of strategies are implemented to efficiently modify oligonucleotides with conjugating partners. The linkers typically used for oligonucleotide conjugation have limitations in terms of stability or ease of synthesis, which generates the need for providing new improved linkers for oligonucleotide conjugation.

pmc-11709651.title: Cortico‐hippocampal dysfunction in APP‐KI and PS1 mouse models
pmc-11709651.creator: Melissa Hernández‐Frausto, Francesca Chinea, Jayeeta Basu
pmc-11709651.description: BackgroundLateral entorhinal cortex (LEC), medial entorhinal cortex (MEC), and hippocampal area exhibit cell damage due to B‐Amyloid depositions, intracellular tau aggregates, and neurofibrillay tangles. AD mouse models allow us to investigate how AD neurodegeneration affects specific brains circuits and resulting behaviors.

pmc-12322901.title: Infant anaphylaxis and epinephrine use: Can we improve acute management?
pmc-12322901.creator: Aikaterini Anagnostou, Matthew Greenhawt, S Shahzad Mustafa, Jay A Lieberman, Marcus Shaker
pmc-12322901.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Anaphylaxis is a serious systemic hypersensitivity reaction that is rapid in onset and may cause death.Methods:The true prevalence of infant anaphylaxis is unknown, but such cases may be increasing in presentation of these patients to emergency departments, with studies that evaluate health-care utilization after implementation of early introduction guidelines that report an increase in the use of emergency department for food-related visits as well as an increase in epinephrine prescriptions for infants.Results:Reasons for these increases may include early food introduction as well

pmc-12423532.title: ROCK 2 inhibition with belumosudil for the treatment of chronic graft-versus-host disease: a narrative review
pmc-12423532.creator: Xiaoqi Wang, Yuqing Liu, Ting Chen, Han Yao, Qingxiao Song, Xi Zhang
pmc-12423532.description: Chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) is a potentially life-threatening complication of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). The global incidence of cGVHD remains high, despite prophylactic regimens for patients undergoing HSCT. Systemic corticosteroids are the standard first-line treatment for cGVHD, but most treated individuals will require second-line or further treatment because of suboptimal disease control or toxicity from long-term corticosteroid use.

pmc-12518375.title: Organizational Spirituality: Refining Its Measurement and Exploring Associations with Individual Spirituality at Work and Job Satisfaction in Poland
pmc-12518375.creator: Marcin Wnuk, Edyta Charzyńska
pmc-12518375.description: Despite the burgeoning interest in workplace spirituality, there remains considerable room for improvement in its conceptualization and measurement. The purpose of this study was to provide a psychometrically sound and easily implementable measure of organizational spirituality. Additionally, the study aimed to differentiate organizational spirituality from individual spirituality at work by examining its unique contributions to job satisfaction.

pmc-12974759.title: Systematic review of the effect of insertion torque on locking screw performance
pmc-12974759.creator: James W A Fletcher
pmc-12974759.description: PurposeLocking plates are well established as a powerful plating concept, especially in low-density bone. Construct strength is dependent on the fixation between the screw head and the plate; however, the influence of variations in the torque used to engage the screw head into the plate hole is unclear.

pmc-13069966.title: Integrated Bioinformatics and Experimental Validation of Inflammatory Cytokine-Related Hub Genes in Pediatric Asthma
pmc-13069966.creator: Mi Mi Gao, Xue Wang, Li Yin, Xiao Ying Wei, Fang Li
pmc-13069966.description: BackgroundAlthough pediatric asthma is closely associated with dysregulated inflammatory cytokines, integrated analyses of inflammatory cytokine-related genes and their potential diagnostic biomarkers remain limited.MethodsGene expression datasets GSE106230 and GSE117038, containing peripheral blood samples from pediatric asthma patients and healthy pediatric controls, were used as training sets, and GSE195599 served as the validation set.

pmc-13288352.title: Spinal motoneuron excitability is homeostatically regulated through β-adrenergic neuromodulation in wild-type and presymptomatic SOD1 mice
pmc-13288352.creator: Stefano Antonucci, Guillaume Caron, Natalie Dikwella, Sruthi Sankari Krishnamurthy, Anthony Harster, Bartosz Wasicki, Hina Zarrin, Aboud Tahanis, Florian olde Heuvel, Simon M Danner, Albert C Ludolph, Kamil Grycz, Marcin Bączyk, Daniel Zytnicki, Francesco Roselli
pmc-13288352.description: Homeostatic feedback loops are essential to stabilize the activity of neurons and neuronal networks. It has been hypothesized that, in the context of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), an excessive gain in feedback loops might hyper- or hypo-excite motoneurons (MNs) and contribute to the pathogenesis.

pmc-13593627.title: Risk factors for multidrug resistance and mortality in healthcare-associated neonatal gram-negative bloodstream infections
pmc-13593627.creator: Hatice Turgut, Ramazan Özdemir, Funda Memişoğlu
pmc-13593627.description: PurposeThis study aimed to characterize pathogen distribution and antimicrobial resistance patterns of gram-negative bloodstream infections in a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit and to determine which factors were associated with multidrug resistance (MDR) and 28-day mortality.MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study, 197 neonates with healthcare-associated gram-negative bloodstream infections diagnosed between January 2010 and December 2025 were included.
